_comment: Err enum members from chia/util/errors.py that are deliberately excluded from REFERENCE.md. These are internal block-validation, consensus, networking, or farming errors that never surface through push_tx or any RPC documented in REFERENCE.md. When a new upstream Err member is added, it must be added EITHER to REFERENCE.md OR to this list — the upstream drift check (check-upstream-drift.js) enforces this.

excluded.DOES_NOT_EXTEND: Internal block-validation error; never returned by push_tx or documented RPCs
excluded.BAD_HEADER_SIGNATURE: Internal consensus error; never returned by push_tx
excluded.MISSING_FROM_STORAGE: Internal storage error; never returned by push_tx
excluded.INVALID_PROTOCOL_MESSAGE: P2P networking violation; not a transaction error
